in_hebrew.name: Tierney
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Little dark one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tierney הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Irish surname O’Tierney which is believed to mean 'descendant of Tiernan'. Tiernan is a Gaelic name which comes from the Old Irish 'tearann' meaning 'dark'. This name carries an association with the ancient Celtic god Tyr, symbolizing courage and strength.
